broad: response to immune response of other organism involved in symbiotic interaction

definition: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of detecting the immune response of the host organism. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: Latent infection - Other responses of Mtb to phagocytosis
